ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of the People's Republic of China on Anti-Money Laundering (2006, as amended); PBOC and State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Order No. 3 (2024), Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information, effective 1 November 2024; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), effective 1 January 2020; Company Registration Regulations of the People's Republic of China (State Council Order No. 746), effective 1 March 2022.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Foreign Parent Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or other competent company registrar in the foreign parent company's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize a true copy in the origin jurisdiction; if the origin jurisdiction is a party to the Hague Apostille Convention, obtain an Apostille Certificate from its designated Competent Authority; if the origin jurisdiction is not a party, obtain Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication and then Consular Legalization from the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that jurisdiction. The Hague Apostille path and the Consular Legalization path are mutually exclusive alternatives and must never be applied in sequence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Active Status)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or other competent company registrar in the foreign parent company's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize a true copy in the origin jurisdiction; if the origin jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention Contracting State, obtain a Hague Apostille; if it is not, obtain Consular Legalization from the PRC Embassy or Consulate after domestic Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication. Never combine Apostille and Consular Legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing WFOE incorporation and appointment of legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the foreign parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Execute before a notary in the origin jurisdiction; then follow exclusively either the Hague Apostille route or the Consular Legalization route depending on the origin jurisdiction's membership in the Apostille Convention. The two routes are parallel and mutually exclusive; sequential chaining is prohibited.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Constitutional Documents) of the Foreign Parent Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign parent company and its notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the certified copy in the origin jurisdiction; if the origin country is an Apostille Convention member, apply for a Hague Apostille; if the origin country is not a member, apply for Consular Legalization at the PRC Embassy or Consulate after local Ministry of Foreign Affairs legalization. These are alternative paths and must not be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Foreign Parent Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding bank of the foreign parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issue on bank letterhead within 90 days before filing; notarize the bank officer's signature in the origin jurisdiction; if the origin jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention state, attach a Hague Apostille; if not, obtain Consular Legalization from the PRC Embassy or Consulate after Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication. The Apostille and Consular paths are mutually exclusive and must never be used sequentially.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before accepting the foreign parent and its ultimate shareholders, the WFOE formation agent must run automated and manual screening against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the United Kingdom Sanctions List, PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs sanctions lists, the Supreme People's Court Judgment Debtor List, and the SAMR blacklist of banned operators. Enhanced due diligence must be applied to all domestic and foreign politically exposed persons, including immediate family members and close associates, with independent verification of source of wealth and source of funds, senior-management approval for escalated risk, and ongoing transaction monitoring integrated with the AML/CFT internal control system.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Registration and Clearance Portal (National Enterprise Name Registration System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name of a WFOE must be in simplified Chinese characters and must follow the four-tier naming convention: administrative division, distinctive name, business scope or industry term, and organizational form. The organizational form must be a limited liability company. An English name may be used for contracts and bank records but is not a substitute for the registered Chinese name; where a phonetic transliteration is adopted, it must follow standard Mandarin Pinyin and must not create similarity or confusion with any existing registered enterprise name or imply state sponsorship. Foreign characters are not permitted in the registered Chinese name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the SAMR online name-clearance system rejects a proposed name, the applicant may, within 15 days from the date of rejection, submit a written appeal to the same municipal SAMR examination department, explaining the distinguishing characters of the proposed name, the relevant industry, and why it is not identical or similar to any pre-existing registered enterprise name. If the municipal SAMR upholds the rejection, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration with the local people's government or the higher-level SAMR within 60 days of receiving the written decision, and may then file an administrative lawsuit in the competent people's court within 6 months of the reconsideration decision. The name reservation window remains suspended while an appeal is pending only if an approved preliminary reservation has already been granted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office, commercial mailbox, or desk-only address is not permissible for this WFOE in the high-voltage substation installation industry. The State Taxation Administration and local tax authorities require a physical operational address for invoice quota verification, VAT control,

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), effective 1 July 2024, Articles 1-11, 26-38, 47-53, 62-71, 178-180; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 2, 4, 15, 28-35; Implementation Regulations of the Foreign Investment Law; Special Administrative Measures (Negative List) for Foreign Investment Access (2021 Edition); Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746, effective 1 March 2022), Articles 1-28.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the district-level Administration for Market Regulation where the registered office is located; foreign investment information filing with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Market Entity Registration Application Form (Company Registration / Filing Application), submitted together with Articles of Association, ownership/shareholder resolutions, address proof, identity documents, and the Foreign Investment Information Report where required; the registry issues the Business License with a Unified Social Credit Code.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum registered capital and no blocked escrow-account requirement apply to a standard Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise under current PRC Company Law and Foreign Investment Law. The Company Law imposes a five-year statutory deadline for shareholders to pay their subscribed capital in full unless applicable sectoral licensing rules require a shorter schedule. For the high-voltage substation installation business, the National Energy Administration permit system may test financial capability through subscribed and paid-in capital, audited net assets, and bonding capacity, so the registered capital must be rationally set at a level sufficient to secure the targeted Electric Power Installation (Maintenance, Testing) Facility Permit class and the relevant construction enterprise qualification. Capital may be contributed in cash or permitted non-cash assets, recorded in the registry, and is subject to stamp duty when paid in; no capital verification certificate is mandatory at the incorporation stage.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF CN_WFOE_LTD
RESOLVED, at the first meeting of the board of directors of CN_WFOE_LTD (the Company), duly convened on [date] at [registered office], with all initial directors present in person or by proxy in accordance with the Articles of Association and the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, the following agenda items were moved, seconded, and adopted unanimously by a valid quorum:
1. Share Capital Subscription. That the subscription statement recorded in the incorporation documents be confirmed; each founding shareholder has irrevocably subscribed to the number and class of shares set out in the register and agrees to pay the consideration in cash or permitted non-cash assets in full compliance with the five-year statutory contribution period. The chairperson is directed to issue contribution call notices, maintain the capital contribution ledger, and deposit the paid-in capital into the Company's designated capital account.
2. Banking Authorization. That [bank name and branch] be appointed as the Company's principal banker and that the following persons be authorized signatories: [names], with a two-signature approval requirement for any payment above [threshold]. The legal representative is authorized to open basic deposit, foreign currency, and documentary credit accounts for project milestone wires and letters of credit and to execute all account agreements, foreign-exchange confirmations, and banking mandates.
3. Registered Office Adoption. That the address stated in the registration application, [full address], is adopted as the Company's statutory registered office and principal place of business until changed by a subsequent board resolution, and the legal representative is authorized to execute lease documents, property consents, and address filings.
4. Statutory Officer Appointments. That [name] is appointed executive director/chairman and legal representative; [name] is appointed general manager, responsible for the 500kV gas-insulated switchgear substation installation business; [name] is appointed supervisor for the purpose of monitoring board conduct; and [name] is appointed compliance and licensing officer with authority to prepare, sign, submit, and query all applications before the State Administration for Market Regulation, the Ministry of Commerce, the National Energy Administration, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, and fire authorities.
5. General Authority. That the legal representative and any two directors, acting jointly, may execute and deliver all contracts, agreements, bank forms, affidavits, statutory declarations, and other documents necessary to carry these resolutions into effect; that the common seal of the Company be affixed in the presence of the legal representative and a witnessing officer; and that all acts previously performed by any officer in connection with the Company's incorporation be ratified. This resolution is effective immediately, remains a true and complete record of the decision making of the board, and may be produced as evidence of corporate authorization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Negative List Clearance and Name Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Integrated Online Government Service Platform and the local Administration for Market Regulation name-reservation window; SAMR Enterprise Registration Portal for name pre-approval.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Perform a mandatory pre-registration legal review against the Negative List for Foreign Investment Access (2021 Edition) to confirm that electrical installation and 500kV gas-insulated switchgear substation work are not in the prohibited or restricted categories. If the ultimate beneficial owner is a foreign person or foreign entity, no special approval is required unless state security sectors apply. Reserve the company name through the SAMR integrated registration platform or the local business hall; the proposed name must consist of an administrative division, company name, industry descriptor, and company type. Submit the official name pre-approval application, including a statement that no similar name exists in the same industry within the relevant administrative area. Use the pre-approval notice to complete the table of shareholders, capital contributions, and registered office description. For a high-voltage substation installation company using the word Power or Electricity, the applicant should confirm with the local market supervision agency that the name is acceptable without separate energy authority consent at the name stage.
required_dossiers: Name pre-approval application form and market entity name reservation form
Proposed company name and trade-name search confirmation
Notarized and legalized certificate of incorporation of the foreign shareholder, or passport copy if the shareholder is a natural person
Power of attorney appointing the local filing representative
Self-assessment statement confirming compliance with the Foreign Investment Negative List
Preliminary Articles of Association and capital contribution schedule
Proof of registered-office availability, including lease or property certificate with landlord consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, obtain the written rejection basis, revise the name using a different administrative division or industry descriptor, or apply for administrative reconsideration before the same SAMR body if the rejection is believed unlawful. If a Negative List risk is identified, restructure the shareholding or business scope to fit a permitted field, or obtain a special security review clearance before re-applying; corrected applications must be accepted within 5 business days of the cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Establishment Registration with SAMR and Seal Carving
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation where the registered office is located, through the SAMR electronic registration portal or the district administrative approval service center.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete establishment registration package on the official SAMR enterprise registration platform or in person at the local administrative approval service center. Ensure that the first board resolution and all director, supervisor, and manager appointments are consistent with the Articles of Association and do not conflict with the disqualification rules under the Company Law. The legal representative, if a foreign national, must submit a valid passport and any additional identity or residency certificate required by the registry. SAMR will review the application, issue the Business License with a Unified Social Credit Code, and return the seal filing record. Immediately after issuance, arrange company chops through an authorized seal-engraving company by presenting the Business License and the legal representative's identity document; the seal specimen must be recorded in the public security online seal-filing system. No capital verification report is required unless the bank or the power-sector license applicant demands one. The registry fee is zero; courier, legalization, and translation costs remain at the applicant's expense.
required_dossiers: Completed Market Entity Registration Application Form
Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
First Board Resolution covering share subscription, officers, and registered office
Identity or passport documents and appointment forms for legal representative, directors, supervisor, and manager
Registered-office proof consisting of lease contract, ownership certificate, and landlord consent
Notarized and legalized corporate documents or passport copies of the foreign shareholder
Name pre-approval notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a correction notice, the applicant has the statutory correction period to remedy the deficiencies without re-filing. If SAMR issues a formal refusal, the applicant may request an administrative review or initiate an administrative lawsuit after receiving the written decision. The common cure for address, identity, or signature defects is to re-execute the relevant documents with notarization and resubmit through the same portal within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Information Reporting, Tax Registration, and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System, State Taxation Administration electronic tax bureau, and a qualified commercial bank authorized to conduct foreign-exchange business.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Business License is issued, file the foreign investment information with the MOFCOM Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System. The filing must disclose enterprise basic information, actual controllers, shareholders, and the business scope covering high-voltage substation installation. At the same time, complete tax registration using the Unified Social Credit Code and enroll in electronic declaration for corporate income tax, value-added tax, urban maintenance and construction tax, stamp duty, and payroll-related social insurance. Open a basic RMB settlement account and a foreign-currency capital account at a bank permitted to receive inbound capital; complete foreign direct investment foreign-exchange registration with the bank and file the receipt of paid-in capital. The bank will conduct AML/KYC checks and may request source-of-funds certificates, corporate structure charts, and the signed Articles of Association. After account opening, apply for a VAT invoice quota sufficient to support construction milestone progress wires and letters of credit.
required_dossiers: Business License and Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Articles of Association and First Board Resolution
Legal representative identity document and company seal impression card
Passport and proof of address of ultimate beneficial owners, with source-of-funds evidence for AML review
Foreign Investment Information Filing form generated by the MOFCOM platform
Tax registration supplementary form and VAT invoice quota statement
Rental contract for registered office and business premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the foreign investment information filing is flagged as late or incorrect, submit a correction filing through the MOFCOM platform with a written explanation; penalties, if any, may be discretionary. If tax registration is delayed, pay any late filing surcharge and apply for administrative reconsideration where the delay is not the applicant's fault. If a bank refuses the account application because of KYC deficiencies, deliver an enhanced due-diligence package containing the beneficial-ownership register, parent company banking references, and a statement explaining the construction project payment rails; the bank must respond in writing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Labor and Statistical Approvals, Power-Sector Licensing, and Occupational Approvals
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and provincial social insurance agencies, local statistical bureau, National Energy Administration provincial regulatory office, provincial Housing and Urban-Rural Development Department, local Emergency Management Bureau, and local Fire and Rescue Division.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the one-stop integrated online government service platform to complete social insurance, housing-fund, and statistical registration within the required period. For the actual power contracting activity, apply to the provincial office of the National Energy Administration for the Electric Power Installation (Maintenance, Testing) Facility Permit, submitting evidence of qualified technical staff, licensed high-voltage electricians, safety management systems, and financial capability. After receiving that permit, apply for the Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate from the housing and urban-rural development authority for specialized electrical installation, and obtain the Work Safety Production License from the appropriate emergency management or construction authority. For 500kV gas-insulated substation projects, finalize fire-protection design review and fire acceptance with the local Fire and Rescue Division and assemble the full technical archive containing the environmental impact assessment approval, SF6 gas management protocol, and hazardous-waste disposal contracts. Only after these licenses are in place may the company bid for and execute 500kV substation work.
required_dossiers: Electric Power Installation (Maintenance, Testing) Facility Permit application and integrity commitment
Technical manager qualification certificates and high-voltage electrician special operation certificates
Safety management institution, hazard identification, and emergency response documents
Financial capability statement showing audited net assets or paid-in capital for the applied permit class
Construction Enterprise Qualification application form, if applicable
Work Safety Production License application with personnel training records
Environmental impact assessment approval and fire protection design review or acceptance documents
Business License, Articles of Association, and social insurance registration certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the National Energy Administration does not grant the power facility permit, request written reasons and file an administrative reconsideration with the competent energy authority or pursue administrative litigation. Deficiencies in technical manpower can be cured by recruiting additional certified electricians and updating the application. If the Work Safety Production License approval is suspended, stop all contracting operations until the hazard rectification notice is closed and reinspection is passed. If fire acceptance is rejected, retain a licensed fire engineer, correct transformer bay separation, oil containment, detection, and suppression deficiencies, and resubmit the dossier.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: National Energy Administration (NEA) provincial regulatory office; provincial Housing and Urban-Rural Development Department; local Emergency Management Bureau; local Fire and Rescue Division; provincial Department of Ecology and Environment.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Electric Power Installation (Maintenance, Testing) Facility Permit, Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate for specialized electrical installation, and Work Safety Production License.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) and its provincial Department of Ecology and Environment, with municipal ecology and environment bureau as the receiving authority for the submitted dossier.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full Environmental Impact Report (Category A / Environmental Impact Report for construction projects) because the work includes a 500kV gas-insulated substation; no construction or installation may commence before the EIA approval is issued in writing. If the baseline project is limited to indoor repair of existing equipment without physical expansion, an Environmental Registration and Filing may be used, but new 500kV GIS installation requires a full EIA Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Comply with GB 12523-2011 for construction site boundary noise (day ≤70 dB(A), night ≤55 dB(A)); GB 12348-2008 for operational noise at the boundary (Class 1: day ≤55 dB(A), night ≤45 dB(A), or the applicable acoustic functional zone limit); GB/T 31962-2015 for wastewater discharged into municipal networks (COD ≤500 mg/L, BOD5 ≤300 mg/L, SS ≤400 mg/L, NH3-N ≤45 mg/L, pH 6-9); GB 16297-1996 for fugitive non-methane hydrocarbons from painting and welding activities (≤4.0 mg/m3 at the boundary); waste transformer oil and oil-contaminated materials as HW08 hazardous waste under code 900-220-08, stored in sealed approved containers and removed by a licensed hazardous-waste transporter within 90 days; SF6-insulated switchgear must maintain an annual leakage rate ≤0.5% per compartment under GB/T 11023, with gas reclaimed through SF6 recovery equipment and no direct atmospheric release.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain the Fire Protection Design Review Opinion and Final Fire Acceptance Certificate from the local Fire and Rescue Division, covering transformer bay oil containment, GIS compartment fire detection and suppression, cable trench fire barriers, and emergency egress. Secure a structural load inspection certificate from a licensed structural engineer for the GIS hall, substation foundations, bus duct supports, and any underground cable vaults. If an underground basement or civil air-defense-protected zone is within the project footprint, obtain the civil air-defense review and approval from the local underground space authority; if none applies, confirm the exemption in writing. Under the Work Safety Law, obtain the Work Safety Production License and register workplace safety files with the Emergency Management Bureau, including high-voltage permit-to-work procedures, live-line operation rules, confined-space entry permits, and emergency rescue arrangements for electrical trauma and SF6 exposure.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; online taxpayer self-service is managed through the STA Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) platform, with provincial e-Tax portals covering the registered address of the CN_WFOE_LTD
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the wholly foreign-owned enterprise under the Foreign Investment Law with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR). Step 2: Obtain the Business License bearing the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC); the USCC is the statutory Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) for VAT and corporate income tax purposes and no separate VAT ID is issued. Step 3: Complete post-incorporation tax information registration through the Electronic Tax Bureau or local tax service hall within 30 days of Business License issuance, confirming the legal representative, financial officer, tax handler, accounting policy, bank account, and authorised VAT invoice applicant. Step 4: File the VAT taxpayer status declaration, either Small-scale or General VAT taxpayer, with the local competent STA branch. Step 5: For a foreign non-resident enterprise that has no Chinese establishment but derives China-source income, the non-resident entity should file non-resident enterprise tax information registration with the STA branch at the location of the payer or withholding agent before performing withholding obligations or claiming treaty benefits.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: The CN_WFOE_LTD is a Chinese resident limited-liability enterprise taxed on worldwide income at the statutory 25% corporate income tax rate; it is not a pass-through entity and no partner or shareholder flow-through treatment is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections; China does not provide an entity-classification election for a WFOE. The only applicable election is the value-added tax status election between Small-scale VAT taxpayer and General VAT taxpayer, and the availability of simplified VAT collection for qualifying construction/installation services under the VAT implementing rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 0 for basic VAT registration; every taxable enterprise must be VAT registered at creation. Mandatory General VAT taxpayer registration arises at RMB 5,000,000 of annual taxable sales; below that threshold, the WFOE may elect Small-scale taxpayer treatment.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Invoicing must be processed through the STA-controlled Golden Tax System and the VAT Invoice Inspection/Verification Platform. VAT invoices are generated through the Electronic Tax Bureau, fully digitalised electronic invoices carry a tax-authority-controlled invoice number and anti-fraud tax-control digital mark, and invoice data is transmitted to the STA in real time at issuance. Taxpayers must reconcile invoice data with each monthly/quarterly VAT return before the relevant filing deadline; abnormal invoices without tax-control clearance are blocked and cannot be used for input VAT credit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods, 0% VAT applies when the goods are physically exported from China under customs supervision, are declared on a valid customs export declaration, and the export proceeds are collected through a designated foreign-exchange bank within the legally prescribed period. For cross-border services, zero-rating or VAT exemption requires the services to be supplied to an overseas party and consumed outside China under the STA cross-border taxable services treatment; installation of a high-voltage substation qualifies only if the service itself is performed abroad or is directly associated with exported goods and the place-of-supply/consumption test is satisfied. A contract with an overseas customer alone is not sufficient; customs clearance, foreign-exchange receipt, and performance evidence are mandatory.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration Form (customs release record of the export goods declaration)
Export Sales Contract and Commercial Invoice
Ocean Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or Railway Consignment Note evidencing cross-border shipment
Inward Remittance Certificate / Foreign Exchange Collection Proof issued by a designated foreign-exchange bank
Export VAT refund/zero-rating declaration data matched to the STA Golden Tax System and customs import/export electronic data
For cross-border installation services: service contract, evidence that the installation site and consumption are outside China, and foreign-currency payment and remittance documentation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA may re-audit any zero-rated export through data matching of customs declarations, foreign-exchange collection, logistics records, and VAT invoice files. If the export is not completed, foreign exchange is not collected within 180 days, required documents are absent, or the declaration is found false or fraudulent, the zero rate is reversed and VAT is assessed at the applicable positive rate (9% for construction/installation services or 13% for goods) plus late-payment interest. Under the Tax Collection and Administration Law, administrative fines range from 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax; fraudulent export-rebate claims can suspend the WFOE's VAT refund/zero-rating rights and expose the entity and responsible persons to criminal liability for fraudulent export tax refund under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, operating under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China maintains a managed floating exchange rate regime with strict capital account controls, while current account transactions are largely fully convertible. For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) in the electrical substation installation sector, foreign direct investment equity injections must be routed through a SAFE-registered capital account, and RMB settlement for current account operating expenses such as procurement of switchgear components, payroll, and subcontractor services enjoys free convertibility after verified authenticity documentation is submitted via the bank's integrated foreign exchange system. Profit remittance and capital repatriation, however, are categorized as capital account items. Dividends can be converted only after annual audit, tax clearance, and board resolution, and the bank will require evidence of the underlying audited retained earnings, tax payment vouchers, and a SAFE-derived remittance approval or registration code. Additionally, all foreign currency receipts related to export proceeds, if any, must be repatriated to China and either retained in designated foreign exchange settlement accounts or converted into RMB through automatic settlement mechanisms; there is no statutory surrender percentage since the 2012 reform, but every transaction must be fully supported by trade contracts, invoices, customs declarations, and logistics documentation. The practical hurdle for profit remittance from an electrical contractor WFOE is the need to reconcile project milestone invoices with actual service completion certificates, as banks and SAFE will scrutinize the commensurate fee for installation and maintenance services, transfer pricing margins, and any intra-group cross-border payments that could mask capital flight. Overall, the currency convertibility environment is viable for genuine trade and investment, but strict regulatory filing sequences and documentary audits necessitate a disciplined treasury operation with a designated SAFE liaison.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE Circular 1 (2020) amendments, export proceeds must be repatriated to China within 180 days from the date of shipment or completion of installation, but there is no mandatory conversion ratio; enterprises may deposit the foreign currency in an export proceeds settlement account with a domestic bank, convert on a voluntary basis, or retain in foreign exchange, subject to the condition that all funds are traceable to legitimate export contracts, customs declarations, and logistics evidence. The enterprise must file an export receipt record with SAFE through its business bank within the stipulated timeline, and any overdue amount without justified force majeure or contract delay is subject to foreign exchange violation penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI Settlement Account) and Basic Operational Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI Settlement Account) and Basic Operational Currency Account
Capital Escrow Account (FDI Settlement Account) and Basic Operational Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability. China's banking regulations require all foreign-invested enterprises to maintain primary operating accounts with SAFE-licensed domestic commercial banks. Offshore fintech EMIs such as Airwallex, Currenxie, or Revolut Business are not permitted to provide deposit-taking or multi-currency corporate accounts to Chinese-domiciled entities without a Chinese banking license. While some fintech companies offer cross-border payment technology platforms through licensed banks, they can only act as software intermediaries and cannot serve as the primary clearing house for capital injection, trade settlement, or dividend repatriation. Any attempt to route WFOE operational cash flows through an unlicensed EMI would trigger a red flag in the bank's anti-money laundering monitoring system and may result in account freeze under PBOC's internal control guidance for corporate banking.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative or an authorized officer holding a notarized power of attorney issued by the company's board must physically appear at the domestic bank branch during the KYC onboarding interview. Remote consular proxy opening is not recognized by Chinese banks for primary account opening. For a WFOE with a foreign shareholder, the bank will also require personal identification documents of all directors and shareholders above 25% beneficial ownership; if the ultimate beneficial owner resides abroad, an original apostilled or consular-legalized certified true copy of the passport and proof of address, together with an in-person signature witnessed by a Chinese consulate or a notary in the owner's jurisdiction, may be accepted, but the final account activation still requires the physical visit of the Chinese-appointed legal representative or local financial officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large cross-border equity injection from an offshore parent company with an unexplained source of funds or disproportionate to the WFOE's initial registered capital.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the board resolution authorizing the capital increase, the signed foreign investment shareholders' agreement, audited financial statements of the foreign investor for the last three years, bank statements evidencing the accumulation of funds from operational or legitimate financing sources, a formal source-of-wealth statement endorsed by an independent asset attorney, and the SAFE FDI registration certificate issued after the pre-plan filing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-layered offshore holding structure involving jurisdictions with perceived low tax transparency (for example, BVI or Cayman holding layers) that obfuscates the ultimate beneficial owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a full UBO chain disclosure showing every intermediate entity from the WFOE to the natural-person shareholder, certified organizational charts, a legal opinion from a registered law firm confirming the legitimacy of the corporate layer, identification and passport copies of all natural persons holding more than 25% ownership or substantive control, and a notarized UBO declaration with signature samples.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound trade disbursements through SWIFT MT103 or LC to third-party beneficiaries not explicitly named in the underlying project contract, especially for procurements destined for suppliers in high-risk or sanctioned-adjacent jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assemble the complete tender-to-installation documentary package, including the master installation contract, original purchase order and detailed invoice from the actual beneficiary, bill of lading or customs clearance record confirming the shipment route and freight, inspection certificates issued by an independent surveyor, end-use attestation for the high-voltage switchgear components, and a background screening report on the beneficiary covering sanctions, sanctions-listing checks, and adverse media.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicious profit pattern with a gross margin substantially below industry benchmarks for electrical subcontracting, suggesting potential transfer pricing manipulation or unrecorded intra-group cash outflows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a contemporaneous transfer pricing study prepared by a licensed tax advisory firm that benchmarks the arm's-length price for installation services, segmental P&L statements allocated by project, cost quotations from independent subcontractors, evidence of operating expenses such as equipment rental and personnel payroll linked directly to the project's milestone delivery, and the annual corporate income tax filing receipts showing no unbooked liabilities.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound foreign direct investment must be remitted through cross-border SWIFT telegraphic transfer using a licensed domestic bank as the receiving bank, with the remitter being the sole foreign shareholder. The bank will first verify the SAFE foreign exchange registration in the capital account system, then convert the funds into a classified capital deposit account with the inward remittance purpose code 'FRW' (foreign exchange for foreign investment) or the corresponding SAFE transaction code for equity investment. After the funds are credited, the receiving bank requires a capital verification report issued by an eligible Chinese CPA firm, which confirms the injection complies with the registered capital schedule and the Articles of Association. The funds then need to be converted into RMB and placed in a ensure capital payee (resident) account only after presenting the tax clearance certificate for the equity contribution. No partial settlement before SAFE filing is permissible.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operational expenditures, the WFOE will use SWIFT MT103 for direct cross-border vendor payments, with proper commercial invoices, tax vouchers, and statement of the underlying unavoidable installation service. For large electrical equipment procurements, the preferred clearing rail is an irrevocable letter of credit (LC) confirmed by a Chinese commercial bank, with LC only payable upon presentation of compliant shipping documents like the commercial invoice, packing list, transport document, inspection certificate from the project owner, and the customs clearance record. Documentary collections may be used for lower-value milestone-based subcontractor settlements, but should be backed byD/P or D/A terms supported by the construction progress certification signed by the Chinese project client. Every outbound disbursement must be reported to SAFE via the bank's automated foreign exchange business reporting platform using the designated trade purpose code, and payments exceeding USD 500,000 will trigger enhanced due diligence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore CNY forward contracts with a licensed Chinese bank, requiring genuine underlying trade or project cash flow and a SAFE registration of the foreign exchange risk exposure

Cross-currency interest rate swaps used exclusively to hedge project finance debt servicing between CNY and foreign currency, provided the notional amount does not exceed the actual outstanding loan balance

CNY options combinations (such as collars or risk reversals) with a domestic bank, where the underlying exposure stems from confirmed foreign currency bids in the electrical construction tendering pipeline

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Information Report (Enterprise Annual Report) published on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / local Market Regulation Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 of the calendar year immediately following the reporting fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Where the WFOE fails to file by June 30, it is marked as an abnormal enterprise in the public credit registry; if no filing is made within three consecutive years, it is included in the Seriously Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprise List, which restricts government procurement, bank credit, and new business registration, and may lead to administrative cancellation of the business license/registration as a strike-off-type forfeiture.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information Annual Report (including UBO and equity structure details)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) jointly administered through SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 annually; shareholding or UBO changes must also be reported separately within 30 calendar days of the transfer event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or materially inaccurate filing is punishable by administrative correction orders and fines of up to RMB 500,000 under the Foreign Investment Information Report Measures; repeated non-compliance may cause SAMR to classify the entity as abnormal and to initiate administrative deregistration/strike-off procedures under the Interim Measures for Enterprise Information Publicity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement and Payment Return (annual CIT reconciliation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) - competent local tax branch
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing and payment due by May 31 of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines of up to RMB 10,000; late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day (18.25% annualized); underpayment subject to an additional interest surcharge and penalties of 50%-500% of tax understated if considered evasion; administrative collection measures include bank account freezing and, for severe cases, cancellation of company registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Annual Financial Statements Audit Report by a licensed PRC Certified Public Accountant and its approval by shareholders
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not filed with a single regulator on a fixed date; retained for inspection by SAMR, STA, MOFCOM, banks, and the foreign investor; a signed copy must be approved at the annual shareholders' meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit and shareholders' approval must occur within 6 months after the fiscal year end (no later than June 30 in practice; if any Chinese financial regulator requires submission, audit report must accompany the relevant filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare or have the statutory annual financial report audited is a violation of PRC Company Law Article 164 and Accounting Law Article 9; responsible directors/legal representative may be subject to fines up to RMB 200,000; the absence of an audit report also blocks tax loss indemnity claims, foreign currency settlement, dividend distribution, and annual credit filing, eventually allowing SAMR to treat the company as non-operational and deregister it.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Related-Party Transaction and Transfer Pricing Disclosure (if connected with foreign investor or any China related party)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) - competent local tax branch
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted with the Annual CIT Return by May 31; contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation must be available within 15 days upon tax authority request and before any cross-border payment made during the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or omitted related-party disclosures trigger special tax adjustment powers, re-assessed taxable income, daily interest at Chinese benchmark lending rate plus 5 percentage points, fines for document retention failures, and potential administrative forfeiture of business license for egregious tax fraud.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: PRC Company Law Article 164 and Accounting Law Article 9 mandate an independent certified CPA audit for every registered Chinese company, including a WFOE, regardless of size; therefore there is no balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemption from the statutory audit itself. For enterprises in the construction/electrical-contracting sector (ISIC 4321/NAICS 238210), additional quantified supervisory triggers are used by regulators to classify the company as a medium or large enterprise: (i) annual construction turnover equal to or exceeding RMB 40 million; (ii) total assets at the balance-sheet date equal to or exceeding RMB 50 million; or (iii) average annual headcount of 300 or more. Once any of those thresholds is satisfied, the enterprise must apply full PRC Accounting Standards (CAS) and present audited financial statements in any construction-qualification renewal, major project tender, credit facility, or foreign-exchange settlement procedure, and the audit report must be issued by a PRC-certified CPA firm registered with the Ministry of Finance and used to corroborate the annual corporate information report.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards (CAS), issued by the Ministry of Finance, substantially converged with IFRS as applicable; construction-specific projects are recognized under CAS 15 'Construction Contracts' and CAS 14 'Revenue' (post-reform); for eligible small enterprises, MOF's simplified PRC Small Enterprise Accounting Standards may be used, but full CAS is the default and mandatory for a WFOE with construction business license and cross-border shareholders.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The WFOE must confirm its ultimate beneficial owner(s), foreign investor chain, and actual controller at least annually through the Foreign Investment Information Annual Report filed with SAMR/MOFCOM during the January 1-June 30 window. Any transfer of equity/shareholding interest (including indirect transfers by a non-resident shareholder) must be reported to SAMR/MOFCOM within 30 calendar days of the completion of transfer, and the company's statutory register of members must be updated on the same date, with the old owner removed and the new UBO recorded after the SAMR share-change filing is made. In addition, any change to the UBO, registered capital, business scope, or name must be filed with SAMR within 30 days from the change before the register is contractually valid against third parties.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory 15% preferential rate for qualifying High and New Technology Enterprises (HNTE); 100% super-deduction for qualifying R&D expenses; 15% encouraged-industry rate in western regions and certain free trade zones; technology transfer income exemption for the first RMB 5 million and 50% reduction on the excess; software/IC enterprise tax holidays available to qualifying system integrators; no separate patent box regime. HNTE and small-medium technology enterprises may carry tax losses forward for 10 years, while the general rule is 5 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return and requisite schedules (A101010, A102010, A105000, A107010, A107012, and related-party transaction forms G100000-G120000) filed through the State Taxation Administration (STA) Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax portal). The WFOE must separately file withholding returns for non-resident dividends, interest, and royalties; this annual return is not a substitute for non-resident withholding declarations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly advance CIT returns are due within 15 days after each quarter-end; annual return is due within 5 months after the fiscal year-end (May 31 for calendar-year filers); final balance payment is due by May 31; books and vouchers must be preserved for 10 years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all revenue from 500kV GIS substation installation contracts, including milestone progress payments, variation orders, and foreign-currency settlements translated at the applicable monthly or periodic average central parity rate; exclude VAT output tax collected from customers; intercompany services to foreign affiliates must be included at arm's length amounts. Any un-invoiced accrued revenue must still be declared if the project has reached the agreed completion stage.

Match installation revenue with direct subcontractor costs, equipment costs, cable and protection-system material costs, and engineering manpower costs under Chinese Accounting Standards. Subcontractor costs are deductible only with compliant VAT special invoices, signed construction/installation contracts, completion certificates, and payment records; costs billed by overseas engineering affiliates require transfer pricing documentation and trigger non-resident withholding on service fees performed in China.

Deduct urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, local education surcharges, stamp duty on engineering contracts, property tax, and land use tax for the relevant tax year. VAT, corporate income tax, criminal fines, and tax late-payment surcharges are not deductible.

Include tender preparation costs, bid bond costs, business development expenses, overseas marketing costs, and entertainment expenses. Entertainment expense is deductible only at 60% and capped at 0.5% of net sales revenue; commissions or agency fees paid to non-resident agents are subject to 10% statutory withholding unless a Double Tax Agreement reduces the rate, and must be supported by agency agreements, service delivery evidence, and withholding records.

Include salaries and Chinese social insurance/housing fund contributions for local project staff, rent, depreciation, legal and accounting fees, and office overhead. Head-office management fees allocated by a foreign parent are not deductible unless supported by actual service agreements, benefit evidence, cost allocation records, and arm's length pricing; related-party service charges must not be duplicated in the foreign and Chinese entities.

Include project loans, bank charges, net foreign-exchange losses, and interest on intercompany borrowings. Deduction of related-party interest is capped by the 2:1 debt-equity thin capitalization ratio and by the arm's length interest rate; interest paid to a non-resident lender triggers 10% statutory withholding, and a reduced DTA rate may apply only after the non-resident lender provides a Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial ownership substantiation.

Report mark-to-market gains or losses on derivatives and financial products. For an electrical installation contractor this line is normally minor; cross-currency swaps hedging USD/EUR project payments must be valued consistently, and realized gains are taxable while substantiated losses are deductible.

Report interest income, dividends received from domestic Chinese investees, and equity investment returns received by the WFOE itself. Dividends received from a Chinese resident enterprise are exempt from corporate income tax; however, dividends distributed by the WFOE to its foreign parent are not declared on this line and instead are subject to non-resident withholding at the time of profit repatriation.

Include taxable government grants, insurance claim receipts, and other operating income. Government grants designated as non-taxable under law must be segregated in a special account, used for the specified purpose, and cannot be claimed as deductible expense if financed by such tax-exempt subsidies.

Calculated by the return as revenue less cost and expenses plus investment and fair-value items. This is an accounting result for operation; no reduction is permitted on this line for planned foreign shareholder distributions.

Include fixed-asset disposal gains, penalties received, donations received, forfeited bid deposits, and insurance compensation for non-operating assets. Any income sourced from a foreign branch must be linked to the foreign tax credit computation if the WFOE claims a credit for foreign taxes paid.

Include charitable donations up to the statutory 12% of annual accounting profit, asset impairment/disposal losses, and other non-operating expenses. Fines and penalties for violating laws or tax regulations are not deductible; losses on related-party receivables require debt-collection evidence and, where due to related parties, transfer pricing analysis.

Must equal audited financial statements before tax adjustments. If the audited profit differs from the filed return, all differences must be itemized in the tax adjustment schedules and explained in the tax filing cover letter. Foreign investors cannot treat accounting profit as automatically distributable without a board resolution and the required withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after tax adjustments and loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add disallowances from Schedule A105000: excessive entertainment, advertising, related-party interest, depreciation differences, asset impairment reversals, and transfer pricing adjustments. Deductible tax losses expire after 5 years under the general rule; HNTE and science-technology SME categories may carry forward 10 years. If transfer pricing documentation was required and not timely prepared, the tax authority may impute profit upward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income and applicable tax rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 25% statutory rate to taxable income, or 15% if HNTE/encouraged-industry qualification is held. A Chinese WFOE is a Chinese tax resident enterprise and is taxed on worldwide income; the offshore parent's residence does not reduce the WFOE's rate. Quarterly prepayments are credited here, and a minimum taxable-income amount cannot be manipulated by intercompany invoice timing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax due or refund after credits and prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute annual tax payable, subtract quarterly advance payments, and claim foreign tax credits only for qualifying foreign-source income with a supporting foreign tax certificate; pay any balance by May 31. Overpayment can be applied or refunded administratively. For non-resident tax declarations, the WFOE as withholding agent must withhold 10% on actual dividend remittance to the foreign parent and file the separate withholding return; treaty relief requires the foreign parent's Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial ownership dossier before the reduced rate is applied, otherwise the tax authority will collect the full statutory withholding plus penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a penalty of up to RMB 2,000, increased to RMB 10,000 for serious cases under TCAL Art. 62; late payment accrues a surcharge of 0.05% per day on the unpaid tax; understating taxable income or evading tax attracts a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax and interest. Fraudulent false invoices or tax evasion above the criminal threshold triggers criminal liability under Criminal Law Arts. 201 and 205, publication on the tax-related untrustworthy party list, exit bans, travel restrictions, seizure of bank accounts, and disqualification from government procurement and tax refund facilitation.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The WFOE, as withholding agent, must verify that the foreign parent is the beneficial owner and treaty resident. To apply a reduced DTA rate, before or at the time of remittance the foreign parent must provide: (i) a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the home jurisdiction tax authority for the relevant period and legalized/apostilled as required; (ii) a completed treaty benefit application under SAT Announcement [2015] No. 60, including the beneficial ownership self-assessment; (iii) the board resolution declaring dividends out of after-tax retained earnings and specifying the exact amount and payment date; and (iv) evidence of economic substance, such as real offices, employees, decision-making power, bank accounts, and absence of a conduit or round-trip arrangement. The reduced treaty rate is not automatic; if the WFOE withholds at 10% because treaty clearance is incomplete, the foreign parent may claim a refund within three years by submitting the required treaty documentation to the competent tax authority.

stage_6.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on interest and royalties paid to non-residents is 10%. Under applicable DTAs, treaties commonly reduce dividend withholding to 5% where the foreign beneficial owner is a company holding at least 25% of the capital, while interest and royalty rates generally are 10% or lower in certain protocols, for example 7% for royalties and 7% or 10% for interest depending on the specific DTA and recipient type. The same TRC and beneficial ownership substantiation requirements apply; royalties for technical services may be recharacterized as service income with potential permanent establishment exposure if the foreign provider performs installation or supervisory activities through personnel present in China.
